scope: Previously authored grt packets; baseline factory lookup language checked individually. No accepted packet changed. flags_b2 candidate search found no literal matches in these findings; broader flags claims pending full consumer review.

records.value: `grTNs_StageData` supplies `Gr_Kind_TNess`, `/GrTNs.dat`, the stage hooks, and a pointer to `grTNs_StageCallbacks` to the stage framework. During common target-stage initialization, a Ground-object ID reaches `grTNess_80222674`, selects `grTNs_StageCallbacks[id]`, and the selected record is installed on the corresponding stage GObj by `Ground_SetupStageCallbacks`; if the GObj lookup fails, the path emits an `OSReport` diagnostic instead.
records.follow_up: Review factory wording against Ground_GetStageGObj allocation and registration at ground.c:817-937. Retain other independent claims only with their own evidence.

records.value: Takes no explicit input and returns no value. It forwards the function pointer `grTNess_80222674` to `Ground_InitTargetStage`; the supplied routine receives a ground-object ID, selects `grTNs_StageCallbacks[id]`, retrieves the corresponding stage GObj, installs that callback row when retrieval succeeds, and returns the GObj.
records.follow_up: Review factory wording against Ground_GetStageGObj allocation and registration at ground.c:817-937. Retain other independent claims only with their own evidence.

records.value: Signature: `HSD_GObj* (int id)`. The signed integer is a Ness Target Test-local Ground/map-object ID used both as an index into the three populated entries of `grTNs_StageCallbacks` and as the argument to `Ground_GetStageGObj`; the return is the configured stage GObj, or `NULL` when lookup fails.
records.follow_up: Review factory wording against Ground_GetStageGObj allocation and registration at ground.c:817-937. Retain other independent claims only with their own evidence.

records.value: The common target-stage initializer receives this function as its object-setup callback. For each supplied stage-local ID, the ID flows in parallel to `grTDr_StageCallbacks[gobj_id]` and `Ground_GetStageGObj(gobj_id)`. On successful lookup, the selected record and object flow into `Ground_SetupStageCallbacks`; the resulting configured object is returned to the initializer. On failure, the ID flows into an `OSReport` diagnostic and `NULL` is returned.
records.follow_up: Review factory wording against Ground_GetStageGObj allocation and registration at ground.c:817-937. Retain other independent claims only with their own evidence.

records.value: A target-stage object setup callback with signature `Ground_GObj* (int gobj_id)`. The integer is a Dr. Mario course-local Ground/map-object ID in the three-entry domain 0 through 2, used both to index `grTDr_StageCallbacks` and to request the corresponding object; the return is the configured Ground GObj, or `NULL` when lookup fails.
records.follow_up: Review factory wording against Ground_GetStageGObj allocation and registration at ground.c:817-937. Retain other independent claims only with their own evidence.

records.value: Obtains and configures one Dr. Mario Target Test Ground object for a requested stage-local object ID. It selects that ID's `StageCallbacks` record, retrieves the corresponding Ground GObj, and delegates installation of the object's lifecycle and process callbacks to the common Ground setup routine.
records.follow_up: Review factory wording against Ground_GetStageGObj allocation and registration at ground.c:817-937. Retain other independent claims only with their own evidence.

records.value: A non-null Ground lookup result transitions into callback-configured stage-object state through `Ground_SetupStageCallbacks`. A null result receives no callback setup; instead, the function reports the failed object ID and returns `NULL`. The function performs no explicit ID bounds check, so its target-stage caller is expected to supply one of the callback table's three populated object IDs.
records.follow_up: Review factory wording against Ground_GetStageGObj allocation and registration at ground.c:817-937. Retain other independent claims only with their own evidence.

records.value: The unit passes its local ground-object factory to `Ground_InitTargetStage`. That factory receives a stage-object ID, indexes the matching `StageCallbacks` row, retrieves the corresponding Ground GObj, installs the row when retrieval succeeds, reports failure otherwise, and returns the object. The installed callbacks then consume each object's `Ground`/JObj state to start map animation, initialize joints, or run common ground updates; the stage-start path separately passes `NULL` to the target generator.
records.follow_up: Review factory wording against Ground_GetStageGObj allocation and registration at ground.c:817-937. Retain other independent claims only with their own evidence.
